about_the_game:
Ready to Build Your Own E-Commerce Empire?

Top Sellers offers an in-depth business simulation that invites you into the heart of the real-world e-commerce experience. Starting from scratch, you’ll fight to transform your small business into a massive brand using strategic moves and creative solutions. Critical decisions—like product selection, inventory management, customer satisfaction, and expanding into global markets—will shape your business every step of the way. The road to success is tough, but reaching the top is worth it all!


What Awaits You in Top Sellers?
📦 Warehouse Management – Control your inventory, expand your space, and prepare orders quickly!



🛒 Wholesale Stores – Seize profitable opportunities and shape your store’s direction!



⚡ Fast Delivery & Drone Shipping – Deliver orders quickly and boost customer satisfaction!



🏆 Leaderboard – Leave your competitors behind!



🚚🌍 Local to Global Trade & Logistics – Prove your strength in the local market, break boundaries, fulfill international orders, and become the Big Boss on the global stage!



🛠️ Second-Hand Market – Buy cheap, sell high! Bargain and gain the advantage!



👥 New Employees – Grow your business and build a strong team!



💰 Finance Management - Banking & Loans – Track tax and rent processes! Manage your finances wisely and accelerate your growth!

🎮 Steam Deck Support – Play anywhere!

PROGRESS & GROWTH

Strategy is your game! Access a wider product range from wholesalers and expand your product selection. Grow your warehouse to stock more products and maintain the order flow. Remember, more orders mean more income.

As your business grows, hire new employees to strengthen your team. Use technology and boost your speed with drone delivery! Offer excellent service to increase your store rating. As your rating rises, you'll receive more orders and climb the Top Sellers leaderboard. Collect badges and advance on your journey to becoming the king of e-commerce!

Exciting Features Coming Soon!

Get ready for a richer experience in Top Sellers! In addition to the features you’ve enjoyed so far, look forward to:

💎 Antiques from the Train – Earn high profits with unique and rare items! 🛤️
📅 Special Day Campaigns – Increase your sales with seasonal opportunities!
🏷️ Seasonal Products – Be ready for every season with summer and winter stock!
🛰️ Fast Delivery with GPS Tracking – Track deliveries in real-time and increase your speed!
🏠 Home Buying & Decoration – Use your earnings to create your own living space!
📊 Detailed Statistics – Analyze data to improve your strategy!

Are you ready to reach the top of the trade world? Let’s get started! 🔥

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
